items.title: perf(plugins): trim metadata refresh lease verification (#182970)
items.summary: perf(plugins): trim metadata refresh lease verification (#182970) Remove five observation-only lease verifications from post-ready plugin metadata refresh. The refresh uses three verification requests instead of eight, reducing its database work from 34 statements and 12 requests to 24 statements and 7 requests. Keep publication and transaction custody checks, local cancellation checks, and database-backed admission for inherited lifecycle scopes that can outlive their outer operation. Include focused count and expiry regressions and a startup benchmark mode that observes completion of the real registry maintenance task.

items.summary: fix(feishu): preserve bot mentions across command admission (#182441) Keep receiving-bot mentions in agent-facing message content, and derive command probes at each decision owner. Preserve abort and btw admission through receive debouncing and sequential routing. Render only locally verified receiving-bot identity for app-scoped bot events, keeping additional recipient restrictions unchanged.
